extension.news: Version 0.1.0 Native menu with Settings, plain-language Help and Build Status. Create, Install and Update / Repair screens are not available yet.
extension.summary: Save and restore your Kodi setup.

extension.description: Build Manager helps you save a Kodi setup and put it on your devices. This version has the main menu, Settings, Help and Build Status. Build Status shows whether Kodi needs a restart or Build Manager needs your attention; comparing a device with a build arrives with Install. The Create, Install and Update / Repair screens are still being built.
